query:
SELECT 
  d.name,
  d.mbtiType->'$.type' as mbti,
  d.publicBio,
  LEFT(d.personality, 50) as personality_preview
FROM digital_twins d
JOIN users u ON d.userId = u.id
WHERE u.openId LIKE 'test_user_%'
ORDER BY d.id;
